name: GlslShaderCompiler
signature: public sealed class GlslShaderCompiler : IShaderCompiler, IDisposable

docs.summary: Compiles GLSLPROGRAM passes to SPIR-V through Prism. Thread safe, one instance can serve every shader.
Changes whenever the compiler session restarts, so passes know a failed compile may now succeed.
Call after included files change, so cached axes are rescanned and failed variants retry.

The globals the pass reads, from its global pragmas, in the order of their specialization constant ids.
